Note: COMI's cutscenes in the order they play. The game data has no single order: each is started by name from a script, so this list is assembled from those scripts (which disc's resource file holds them, the room they belong to, and the order counting scripts play them in). Room is the room the starting script belongs to. Title is optional and shown in the media player; Note says what the order rests on.
